summary: Phase 7 (Stage B's second phase) landed: contexts, hole filling, and output pruning, in a new Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/Constructive/Nested/Context.lean module. OutputCtx (List NestedLhs, Observation 2.2 eq. 2.2) with all four fill operations (empty/LHS/RHS/full); InputCtx (eq. 2.3) with fillLhs/fillEmpty; output pruning (Definition 2.3, landed as list append); two equational lemmas. Example 2.1's Gamma1{}/Gamma2{} land as OutputCtx/InputCtx values with Gamma{empty} verified by rfl against the paper, plus cross-validation against Phase 6's already-landed concrete terms. Documented, forced deviation: InputCtx's Pi field is typed NestedRhs Atom (not Proposition, per the plan sketch) -- the source's own Greek-vs-roman-letter convention forces this, verified by full derivation against the cited Example 2.1 Gamma2{} case. Lean field spelled lowercase pi (Mathlib binds capital Pi as a delaborator token). 7/32 phases done. Stages C-G not started.
decisions_made: InputCtx.pi typed NestedRhs Atom, not Proposition (plan's original sketch): the source's own notational convention (capital Greek letters denote arbitrary sequents, roman letters denote atomic formulas) forces this -- Example 2.1's Gamma2{} decomposed per eq. (2.3) gives a compound pi = [B,C], not a bare atom. Typing pi as Proposition would make Phase 7's own cited verification example inexpressible. Full derivation documented in Context.lean's module docstring.

InputCtx's field spelled lowercase 'pi' (Greek), not capital 'Pi': Mathlib's Delaborators.lean binds capital Pi as a Pi-type delaborator token, confirmed unusable as a plain identifier by a parse failure.

InputCtx lands only fillLhs and fillEmpty (not also fillRhs/fillFull): the source never states a typing rule for filling an input context with RHS/full-sequent fillers; scoped to what's textually grounded rather than inventing an unmotivated formula.

The '(Gamma-pruned){Delta} vs Gamma{Delta}' equational relationship (part of Phase 7's own task list) is deferred to Phase 8: natural candidate structural equalities don't hold as bare equalities, and Phase 8's fm-compositionality apparatus is where the correct (likely fm-level, not raw-term) form of this relationship should emerge.

Landed as a new sibling file Nested/Context.lean rather than extending Syntax.lean: Syntax.lean was already 173 lines and Phase 7's content would have pushed well past the plan's own 350-line splitting threshold.
